meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里的未使用代码,用语言服务器确认每个候选确实无人引用,再按文件分批,并行派出多个子代理删除并分别提交。最后跑类型检查与测试,汇报删了什么。它只做协调,不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup”等关键词,或表示要清理未使用代码时触发。

say.text: 请移除这个项目里的死代码
say.note: Claude 会开始全项目扫描并清理

say.text: 检查 src 目录,找出没用的导出并清理
say.note: 扫描范围限定在 src 目录

say.text: 清理未使用的导入和变量
say.note: 会删除未使用的导入、变量等

howto.what_en: Scans for unused code, verifies via language server, batches by file, then parallel sub-agents delete them in atomic commits. Runs typecheck/tests and reports. Orchestrates only; doesn't edit code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', etc., or ask to clean up unused code.

say_en.text: Please remove dead code from this project.
say_en.note: Claude will start scanning and cleaning.

say_en.text: Check the src directory and clean up unused exports.
say_en.note: Scan will be scoped to src.

say_en.text: Clean up unused imports and variables.
